speaker: gabriel
text: Do not be afraid, Zechariah, because your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to give him the name John.
name: The angel Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: He will be a joy and delight to you, and many will rejoice at his birth,
name: The angel Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: for he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He shall never take wine or strong drink, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even from his mother’s womb.
name: The angel Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: Many of the sons of Israel he will turn back to the Lord their God.
name: The angel Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: And he will go on before the Lord in the spirit and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the fathers to their children and the disobedient to the wisdom of the righteous—to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.
name: The angel Gabriel

speaker: zechariah
text: How can I be sure of this?
name: Zechariah

speaker: zechariah
text: I am an old man, and my wife is well along in years.
name: Zechariah

speaker: gabriel
text: I am Gabriel,
name: The angel Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: I stand in the presence of God, and I have been sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
name: The angel Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: And now you will be silent and unable to speak until the day this comes to pass, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled at their proper time.
name: The angel Gabriel

speaker: elizabeth
text: The Lord has done this for me. In these days He has shown me favor and taken away my disgrace among the people.
name: Elizabeth

speaker: gabriel
text: Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you.
name: The angel Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: Do not be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.
name: The angel Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: Behold, you will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus.
name: The angel Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David,
name: The angel Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: and He will reign over the house of Jacob forever. His kingdom will never end!
name: The angel Gabriel

speaker: mary
text: How can this be,
name: Mary

speaker: mary
text: since I am a virgin?
name: Mary

speaker: gabriel
text: The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. So the Holy One to be born will be called the Son of God.
name: The angel Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: Look, even Elizabeth your relative has conceived a son in her old age, and she who was called barren is in her sixth month.
name: The angel Gabriel

speaker: gabriel
text: For no word from God will ever fail.
name: The angel Gabriel

speaker: mary
text: I am the Lord’s servant,
name: Mary

speaker: mary
text: May it happen to me according to your word.
name: Mary

speaker: elizabeth
text: Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!
name: Elizabeth

speaker: elizabeth
text: And why am I so honored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?
name: Elizabeth

speaker: elizabeth
text: For as soon as the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy.
name: Elizabeth

speaker: elizabeth
text: Blessed is she who has believed that the Lord’s word to her will be fulfilled.
name: Elizabeth

speaker: mary
text: My soul magnifies the Lord,
name: Mary

speaker: mary
text: and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior!
name: Mary

speaker: mary
text: For He has looked with favor on the humble state of His servant. From now on all generations will call me blessed.
name: Mary

speaker: mary
text: For the Mighty One has done great things for me. Holy is His name.
name: Mary

speaker: mary
text: His mercy extends to those who fear Him, from generation to generation.
name: Mary

speaker: mary
text: He has performed mighty deeds with His arm; He has scattered those who are proud in the thoughts of their hearts.
name: Mary

speaker: mary
text: He has brought down rulers from their thrones, but has exalted the humble.
name: Mary

speaker: mary
text: He has filled the hungry with good things, but has sent the rich away empty.
name: Mary

speaker: mary
text: He has helped His servant Israel, remembering to be merciful,
name: Mary

speaker: mary
text: as He promised to our fathers, to Abraham and his descendants forever.
name: Mary

speaker: elizabeth
text: No! He shall be called John.
name: Elizabeth

speaker: relatives
text: There is no one among your relatives who bears this name.
name: The relatives

speaker: zechariah
text: His name is John.
name: Zechariah

speaker: neighbors
text: What then will this child become?
name: The neighbors

speaker: zechariah
text: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, because He has visited and redeemed His people.
name: Zechariah

speaker: zechariah
text: He has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of His servant David,
name: Zechariah

speaker: zechariah
text: as He spoke through His holy prophets, those of ages past,
name: Zechariah

speaker: zechariah
text: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us,
name: Zechariah

speaker: zechariah
text: to show mercy to our fathers and to remember His holy covenant,
name: Zechariah

speaker: zechariah
text: the oath He swore to our father Abraham, to grant us
name: Zechariah

speaker: zechariah
text: deliverance from hostile hands, that we may serve Him without fear,
name: Zechariah

speaker: zechariah
text: in holiness and righteousness before Him all the days of our lives.
name: Zechariah

speaker: zechariah
text: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go on before the Lord to prepare the way for Him,
name: Zechariah

speaker: zechariah
text: to give to His people the knowledge of salvation through the forgiveness of their sins,
name: Zechariah

speaker: zechariah
text: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the Dawn will visit us from on high,
name: Zechariah

speaker: zechariah
text: to shine on those who live in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the path of peace.
name: Zechariah

speaker: angel
text: Do not be afraid! For behold, I bring you good news of great joy that will be for all the people:
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: angel
text: Today in the city of David a Savior has been born to you. He is Christ the Lord!
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: angel
text: And this will be a sign to you: You will find a baby wrapped in swaddling cloths and lying in a manger.
name: An angel of the Lord

speaker: heavenly-host
text: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace to men on whom His favor rests!
name: The heavenly host

speaker: shepherds
text: Let us go to Bethlehem and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.
name: The shepherds

speaker: simeon
text: Sovereign Lord, as You have promised, You now dismiss Your servant in peace.
name: Simeon

speaker: simeon
text: For my eyes have seen Your salvation,
name: Simeon

speaker: simeon
text: which You have prepared in the sight of all people,
name: Simeon

speaker: simeon
text: a light for revelation to the Gentiles, and for glory to Your people Israel.
name: Simeon

speaker: simeon
text: Behold, this Child is appointed to cause the rise and fall of many in Israel, and to be a sign that will be spoken against,
name: Simeon

speaker: simeon
text: so that the thoughts of many hearts will be revealed— and a sword will pierce your soul as well.
name: Simeon

speaker: mary
text: Child, why have You done this to us?
name: Mary

speaker: mary
text: Your father and I have been anxiously searching for You.
name: Mary

speaker: jesus
text: Why were you looking for Me?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Did you not know that I had to be in My Father’s house?
name: Jesus

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: You brood of vipers, who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: Produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance. And do not begin to say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ For I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: The axe lies ready at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: crowd
text: What then should we do?
name: The crowd

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: Whoever has two tunics should share with him who has none, and whoever has food should do the same.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: tax-collectors
text: Teacher,
name: The tax collectors

speaker: tax-collectors
text: what should we do?
name: The tax collectors

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: Collect no more than you are authorized,
name: John the Baptist

speaker: soldiers
text: And what should we do?
name: The soldiers

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: Do not take money by force or false accusation,
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: Be content with your wages.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: I baptize you with water, but One more powerful than I will come, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: His winnowing fork is in His hand to clear His threshing floor and to gather the wheat into His barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.
name: John the Baptist

speaker: god
text: You are My beloved Son; in You I am well pleased.
name: God the Father

speaker: satan
text: If You are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread.
name: The devil

speaker: jesus
text: It is written: ‘Man shall not live on bread alone.’
name: Jesus

speaker: satan
text: I will give You authority over all these kingdoms and all their glory,
name: The devil

speaker: satan
text: For it has been relinquished to me, and I can give it to anyone I wish.
name: The devil

speaker: satan
text: So if You worship me, it will all be Yours.
name: The devil

speaker: jesus
text: It is written: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve Him only.’
name: Jesus

speaker: satan
text: If You are the Son of God,
name: The devil

speaker: satan
text: throw Yourself down from here.
name: The devil

speaker: satan
text: For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You to guard You carefully;
name: The devil

speaker: satan
text: and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’
name: The devil

speaker: jesus
text: It also says, ‘Do not put the Lord your God to the test.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Today this Scripture is fulfilled in your hearing.
name: Jesus

speaker: nazareth-crowd
text: Isn’t this the son of Joseph?
name: The people of Nazareth

speaker: jesus
text: Surely you will quote this proverb to Me: ‘Physician, heal yourself! Do here in Your hometown what we have heard that You did in Capernaum.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, no prophet is accepted in his hometown.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I tell you truthfully that there were many widows in Israel in the time of Elijah, when the sky was shut for three and a half years and great famine swept over all the land.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Yet Elijah was not sent to any of them, but to the widow of Zarephath in Sidon.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And there were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet. Yet not one of them was cleansed—only Naaman the Syrian.
name: Jesus

speaker: unclean-spirit
text: Ha! What do You want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have You come to destroy us? I know who You are—the Holy One of God!
name: The unclean spirit

speaker: jesus
text: Be silent!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Come out of him!
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: What is this message? With authority and power He commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!
name: The crowd

speaker: demons
text: You are the Son of God!
name: The demons

speaker: jesus
text: I must preach the good news of the kingdom of God to the other towns as well, because that is why I was sent.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Put out into deep water and let down your nets for a catch.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Master,
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: we have worked hard all night without catching anything. But because You say so, I will let down the nets.
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: Go away from me, Lord,
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: for I am a sinful man.
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Do not be afraid,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: From now on you will catch men.
name: Jesus

speaker: leper
text: Lord, if You are willing, You can make me clean.
name: A leper

speaker: jesus
text: I am willing,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Be clean!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not tell anyone,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But go, show yourself to the priest and present the offering Moses prescribed for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Friend, your sins are forgiven.
name: Jesus

speaker: scribes
text: Who is this man who speaks blasphemy? Who can forgive sins but God alone?
name: The scribes and Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: Why are you thinking these things in your hearts?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Which is easier: to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up and walk?’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on the earth to forgive sins...
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I tell you, get up, pick up your mat, and go home.
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: We have seen remarkable things today.
name: The crowd

speaker: jesus
text: Follow Me,
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: Why do you eat and drink with tax collectors and sinners?
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: John’s disciples and those of the Pharisees frequently fast and pray, but Yours keep on eating and drinking.
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: Can you make the guests of the bridegroom fast while He is with them?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them; then they will fast.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: No one tears a piece of cloth from a new garment and sews it on an old one. If he does, he will tear the new garment as well, and the patch from the new will not match the old.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the new wine will burst the skins, the wine will spill, and the wineskins will be ruined.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Instead, new wine is poured into new wineskins.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And no one after drinking old wine wants new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: Why are you doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: Have you not read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He entered the house of God, took the consecrated bread and gave it to his companions, and ate what is lawful only for the priests to eat.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Get up and stand among us.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I ask you, which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Stretch out your hand.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the kingdom of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed are you when people hate you, and when they exclude you and insult you and reject your name as evil because of the Son of Man.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, because great is your reward in heaven. For their fathers treated the prophets in the same way.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But woe to you who are rich, for you have already received your comfort.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Woe to you who are well fed now, for you will hunger. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Woe to you when all men speak well of you, for their fathers treated the false prophets in the same way.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But to those of you who will listen, I say: Love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: bless those who curse you, pray for those who mistreat you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If someone strikes you on one cheek, turn to him the other also. And if someone takes your cloak, do not withhold your tunic as well.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Give to everyone who asks you, and if anyone takes what is yours, do not demand it back.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do to others as you would have them do to you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners love those who love them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners do the same.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And if you lend to those from whom you expect repayment, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, expecting to be repaid in full.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But love your enemies, do good to them, and lend to them, expecting nothing in return. Then your reward will be great, and you will be sons of the Most High; for He is kind to the ungrateful and wicked.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not judge, and you will not be judged. Do not condemn, and you will not be condemned. Forgive, and you will be forgiven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over will be poured into your lap. For with the measure you use, it will be measured back to you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Can a blind man lead a blind man? Will they not both fall into a pit?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone who is fully trained will be like his teacher.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Why do you look at the speck in your brother’s eye, but fail to notice the beam in your own eye?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: How can you say, ‘Brother, let me take the speck out of your eye,’ while you yourself fail to see the beam in your own eye? You hypocrite! First take the beam out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to remove the speck from your brother’s eye.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: No good tree bears bad fruit, nor does a bad tree bear good fruit.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For each tree is known by its own fruit. Indeed, figs are not gathered from thornbushes, nor grapes from brambles.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The good man brings good things out of the good treasure of his heart, and the evil man brings evil things out of the evil treasure of his heart. For out of the overflow of the heart, the mouth speaks.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Why do you call Me ‘Lord, Lord,’ but not do what I say?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I will show you what he is like who comes to Me and hears My words and acts on them:
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He is like a man building a house, who dug down deep and laid his foundation on the rock. When the flood came, the torrent crashed against that house but could not shake it, because it was well built.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But the one who hears My words and does not act on them is like a man who built his house on ground without a foundation. The torrent crashed against that house, and immediately it fell—and great was its destruction!
name: Jesus

speaker: jewish-elders
text: This man is worthy to have You grant this,
name: The Jewish elders

speaker: jewish-elders
text: for he loves our nation and has built our synagogue.
name: The Jewish elders

speaker: centurion
text: Lord, do not trouble Yourself, for I am not worthy to have You come under my roof.
name: The centurion's friends

speaker: centurion
text: That is why I did not consider myself worthy to come to You. But just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
name: The centurion's friends

speaker: centurion
text: For I myself am a man under authority, with soldiers under me. I tell one to go, and he goes; and another to come, and he comes. I tell my servant to do something, and he does it.
name: The centurion's friends

speaker: jesus
text: I tell you, not even in Israel have I found such great faith.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not weep.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Young man,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I tell you, get up!
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: A great prophet has appeared among us!
name: The crowd

speaker: crowd
text: God has visited His people!
name: The crowd

speaker: john-the-baptist
text: Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?
name: John the Baptist

speaker: johns-disciples
text: John the Baptist sent us to ask, ‘Are You the One who was to come, or should we look for someone else?’
name: John's disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Go back and report to John what you have seen and heard: The blind receive sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the good news is preached to the poor.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed is the one who does not fall away on account of Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed swaying in the wind?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Otherwise, what did you go out to see? A man dressed in fine clothes? Look, those who wear elegant clothing and live in luxury are found in palaces.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What then did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and more than a prophet.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This is the one about whom it is written: ‘Behold, I will send My messenger ahead of You, who will prepare Your way before You.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I tell you, among those born of women there is no one greater than John, yet even the least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: To what, then, can I compare the men of this generation? What are they like?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: They are like children sitting in the marketplace and calling out to one another: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not weep.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon!’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Look at this glutton and drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But wisdom is vindicated by all her children.
name: Jesus

speaker: simon-pharisee
text: If this man were a prophet, He would know who this is and what kind of woman is touching Him—for she is a sinner!
name: Simon the Pharisee

speaker: jesus
text: Simon, I have something to tell you.
name: Jesus

speaker: simon-pharisee
text: Tell me, Teacher,
name: Simon the Pharisee

speaker: jesus
text: Two men were debtors to a certain moneylender. One owed him five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When they were unable to repay him, he forgave both of them. Which one, then, will love him more?
name: Jesus

speaker: simon-pharisee
text: I suppose the one who was forgiven more,
name: Simon the Pharisee

speaker: jesus
text: You have judged correctly,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do you see this woman? When I entered your house, you did not give Me water for My feet, but she wet My feet with her tears and wiped them with her hair.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You did not greet Me with a kiss, but she has not stopped kissing My feet since I arrived.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You did not anoint My head with oil, but she has anointed My feet with perfume.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore I tell you, because her many sins have been forgiven, she has loved much. But he who has been forgiven little loves little.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Your sins are forgiven.
name: Jesus

speaker: guests
text: Who is this who even forgives sins?
name: Those at the table

speaker: jesus
text: Your faith has saved you; go in peace.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: A farmer went out to sow his seed. And as he was sowing, some seed fell along the path, where it was trampled, and the birds of the air devoured it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Some fell on rocky ground, and when it came up, the seedlings withered because they had no moisture.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up with it and choked the seedlings.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Still other seed fell on good soil, where it sprang up and produced a crop—a hundredfold.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of God has been given to you, but to others I speak in parables, so that, ‘though seeing, they may not see; though hearing, they may not understand.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Now this is the meaning of the parable: The seed is the word of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The seeds along the path are those who hear, but the devil comes and takes away the word from their hearts, so that they may not believe and be saved.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The seeds on rocky ground are those who hear the word and receive it with joy, but they have no root. They believe for a season, but in the time of testing, they fall away.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The seeds that fell among the thorns are those who hear, but as they go on their way, they are choked by the worries, riches, and pleasures of this life, and their fruit does not mature.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But the seeds on good soil are those with a noble and good heart, who hear the word, cling to it, and by persevering produce a crop.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: No one lights a lamp and covers it with a jar or puts it under a bed. Instead, he sets it on a stand, so those who enter can see the light.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For there is nothing hidden that will not be disclosed, and nothing concealed that will not be made known and brought to light.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Pay attention, therefore, to how you listen. Whoever has will be given more, but whoever does not have, even what he thinks he has will be taken away from him.
name: Jesus

speaker: someone
text: Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to see You.
name: Someone in the crowd

speaker: jesus
text: My mother and brothers are those who hear the word of God and carry it out.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Let us cross to the other side of the lake.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Master, Master, we are perishing!
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Where is your faith?
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Who is this? He commands even the winds and the water, and they obey Him!
name: The disciples

speaker: demoniac
text: What do You want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I beg You not to torture me!
name: The demon-possessed man

speaker: jesus
text: What is your name?
name: Jesus

speaker: demoniac
text: Legion,
name: The demon-possessed man

speaker: jesus
text: Return home and describe how much God has done for you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Who touched Me?
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Master,
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: the people are crowding and pressing against You.
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Someone touched Me, for I know that power has gone out from Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Daughter,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: your faith has healed you. Go in peace.
name: Jesus

speaker: messenger
text: Your daughter is dead,
name: A messenger from Jairus's house

speaker: messenger
text: Do not bother the Teacher anymore.
name: A messenger from Jairus's house

speaker: jesus
text: Do not be afraid; just believe, and she will be healed.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Stop weeping; she is not dead but asleep.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Child, get up!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Take nothing for the journey,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: no staff, no bag, no bread, no money, no second tunic.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whatever house you enter, stay there until you leave that area.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If anyone does not welcome you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave that town, as a testimony against them.
name: Jesus

speaker: herod
text: I beheaded John,
name: Herod

speaker: herod
text: but who is this man I hear such things about?
name: Herod

speaker: disciples
text: Dismiss the crowd so they can go to the surrounding villages and countryside for lodging and provisions. For we are in a desolate place here.
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: You give them something to eat.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: We have only five loaves of bread and two fish,
name: The disciples

speaker: disciples
text: unless we go and buy food for all these people.
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Have them sit down in groups of about fifty each.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Who do the crowds say I am?
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, that a prophet of old has arisen.
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: But what about you?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Who do you say I am?
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: The Christ of God.
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: The Son of Man must suffer many things,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He must be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and He must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life for My sake will save it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What does it profit a man to gain the whole world, yet lose or forfeit his very self?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If anyone is ashamed of Me and My words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when He comes in His glory and in the glory of the Father and of the holy angels.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I tell you truthfully, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the kingdom of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Master, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.
name: Peter

speaker: god
text: This is My Son, whom I have chosen. Listen to Him!
name: God the Father

speaker: father
text: Teacher, I beg You to look at my son, for he is my only child.
name: The boy's father

speaker: father
text: A spirit keeps seizing him, and he screams abruptly. It throws him into convulsions so that he foams at the mouth. It keeps mauling him and rarely departs from him.
name: The boy's father

speaker: father
text: I begged Your disciples to drive it out, but they were unable.
name: The boy's father

speaker: jesus
text: O unbelieving and perverse generation!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: How long must I remain with you and put up with you? Bring your son here.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Let these words sink into your ears: The Son of Man is about to be delivered into the hands of men.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whoever welcomes this little child in My name welcomes Me, and whoever welcomes Me welcomes the One who sent Me. For whoever is the least among all of you, he is the greatest.
name: Jesus

speaker: john-apostle
text: Master,
name: John

speaker: john-apostle
text: we saw someone driving out demons in Your name, and we tried to stop him, because he does not accompany us.
name: John

speaker: jesus
text: Do not stop him,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: for whoever is not against you is for you.
name: Jesus

speaker: james-and-john
text: Lord, do You want us to call down fire from heaven to consume them?
name: James and John

speaker: man
text: I will follow You wherever You go.
name: A man

speaker: jesus
text: Foxes have dens and birds of the air have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay His head.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Follow Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: man
text: Lord, first let me go and bury my father.
name: A man

speaker: jesus
text: Let the dead bury their own dead. You, however, go and proclaim the kingdom of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: man
text: I will follow You, Lord; but first let me bid farewell to my family.
name: A man

speaker: jesus
text: No one who puts his hand to the plow and then looks back is fit for the kingdom of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few. Ask the Lord of the harvest, therefore, to send out workers into His harvest.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Go! I am sending you out like lambs among wolves.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Carry no purse or bag or sandals. Do not greet anyone along the road.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whatever house you enter, begin by saying, ‘Peace to this house.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If a man of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; if not, it will return to you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Stay at the same house, eating and drinking whatever you are offered. For the worker is worthy of his wages. Do not move around from house to house.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If you enter a town and they welcome you, eat whatever is set before you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘The kingdom of God is near you.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But if you enter a town and they do not welcome you, go into the streets and declare,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘Even the dust of your town that clings to our feet, we wipe off as a testimony against you. Yet be sure of this: The kingdom of God is near.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I tell you, it will be more bearable on that day for Sodom than for that town.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment than for you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to heaven? No, you will be brought down to Hades!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whoever listens to you listens to Me; whoever rejects you rejects Me; and whoever rejects Me rejects the One who sent Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: seventy-two
text: Lord, even the demons submit to us in Your name.
name: The seventy-two

speaker: jesus
text: I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Behold, I have given you authority to tread on snakes and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will harm you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Nevertheless, do not rejoice that the spirits submit to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for this was well-pleasing in Your sight.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed are the eyes that see what you see.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.
name: Jesus

speaker: expert-in-law
text: Teacher,
name: An expert in the law

speaker: expert-in-law
text: what must I do to inherit eternal life?
name: An expert in the law

speaker: jesus
text: What is written in the Law?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: How do you read it?
name: Jesus

speaker: expert-in-law
text: ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength and with all your mind’ and ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’
name: An expert in the law

speaker: jesus
text: You have answered correctly,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do this and you will live.
name: Jesus

speaker: expert-in-law
text: And who is my neighbor?
name: An expert in the law

speaker: jesus
text: A man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho when he fell into the hands of robbers. They stripped him, beat him, and went away, leaving him half dead.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Now by chance a priest was going down the same road, but when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So too, when a Levite came to that spot and saw him, he passed by on the other side.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But when a Samaritan on a journey came upon him, he looked at him and had compassion.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He went to him and bandaged his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. Then he put him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The next day he took out two denarii and gave them to the innkeeper. ‘Take care of him,’ he said, ‘and on my return I will repay you for any additional expense.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Which of these three do you think was a neighbor to the man who fell into the hands of robbers?
name: Jesus

speaker: expert-in-law
text: The one who showed him mercy,
name: An expert in the law

speaker: jesus
text: Go and do likewise.
name: Jesus

speaker: martha
text: Lord, do You not care that my sister has left me to serve alone? Tell her to help me!
name: Martha

speaker: jesus
text: Martha, Martha,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: you are worried and upset about many things.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen the good portion, and it will not be taken away from her.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciple
text: Lord, teach us to pray, just as John taught his disciples.
name: One of the disciples

speaker: jesus
text: When you pray, say: ‘Father, hallowed be Your name. Your kingdom come.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Give us each day our daily bread.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And forgive us our sins, for we also forgive everyone who sins against us. And lead us not into temptation.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Suppose one of you goes to his friend at midnight and says, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: because a friend of mine has come to me on a journey, and I have nothing to set before him.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And suppose the one inside answers, ‘Do not bother me. My door is already shut, and my children and I are in bed. I cannot get up to give you anything.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I tell you, even though he will not get up to provide for him because of his friendship, yet because of the man’s persistence, he will get up and give him as much as he needs.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So I tell you: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What father among you, if his son asks for a fish, will give him a snake instead?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Or if he asks for an egg, will give him a scorpion?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him!
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: It is by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons, that He drives out demons.
name: The crowd

speaker: jesus
text: Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and a house divided against a house will fall.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If Satan is divided against himself, how can his kingdom stand? After all, you say that I drive out demons by Beelzebul.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But if I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When a strong man, fully armed, guards his house, his possessions are secure.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But when someone stronger attacks and overpowers him, he takes away the armor in which the man trusted, and then he divides up his plunder.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He who is not with Me is against Me, and he who does not gather with Me scatters.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When an unclean spirit comes out of a man, it passes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it. Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: On its return, it finds the house swept clean and put in order.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then it goes and brings seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and dwell there. And the final plight of that man is worse than the first.
name: Jesus

speaker: woman-in-crowd
text: Blessed is the womb that bore You, and blessed are the breasts that nursed You!
name: A woman in the crowd

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This is a wicked generation. It demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will be a sign to this generation.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with the men of this generation and condemn them; for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and now One greater than Solomon is here.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The men of Nineveh will stand at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now One greater than Jonah is here.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: No one lights a lamp and puts it in a cellar or under a basket. Instead, he sets it on a stand, so those who enter can see the light.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Your eye is the lamp of your body. When your eyes are good, your whole body also is full of light. But when they are bad, your body is full of darkness.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Be careful, then, that the light within you is not darkness.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So if your whole body is full of light, with no part of it in darkness, you will be radiant, as though a lamp were shining on you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Now then,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside you are full of greed and wickedness.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You fools! Did not the One who made the outside make the inside as well?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But give as alms the things that are within you, and you will see that everything is clean for you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Woe to you Pharisees! You pay tithes of mint, rue, and every herb, but you disregard justice and the love of God. You should have practiced the latter without neglecting the former.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Woe to you Pharisees! You love the chief seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Woe to you! For you are like unmarked graves, which men walk over without even noticing.
name: Jesus

speaker: expert-in-law
text: Teacher, when You say these things, You insult us as well.
name: An expert in the law

speaker: jesus
text: Woe to you as well, experts in the law!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You weigh men down with heavy burdens, but you yourselves will not lift a finger to lighten their load.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Woe to you! You build tombs for the prophets, but it was your fathers who killed them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So you are witnesses consenting to the deeds of your fathers: They killed the prophets, and you build their tombs.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Because of this, the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send them prophets and apostles; some of them they will kill and others they will persecute.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: As a result, this generation will be charged with the blood of all the prophets that has been shed since the foundation of the world,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah, who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary. Yes, I tell you, all of it will be charged to this generation.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Woe to you experts in the law! For you have taken away the key to knowledge. You yourselves have not entered, and you have hindered those who were entering.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed, and nothing hidden that will not be made known.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What you have spoken in the dark will be heard in the daylight, and what you have whispered in the inner rooms will be proclaimed from the housetops.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I tell you, My friends, do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that can do no more.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I will show you whom you should fear: Fear the One who, after you have been killed, has authority to throw you into hell. Yes, I tell you, fear Him!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies? Yet not one of them is forgotten by God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I tell you, everyone who confesses Me before men, the Son of Man will also confess him before the angels of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But whoever denies Me before men will be denied before the angels of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When you are brought before synagogues, rulers, and authorities, do not worry about how to defend yourselves or what to say.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For at that time the Holy Spirit will teach you what you should say.
name: Jesus

speaker: someone
text: Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.
name: Someone in the crowd

speaker: jesus
text: Man, who appointed Me judge or executor between you?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Watch out! Guard yourselves against every form of greed, for one’s life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The ground of a certain rich man produced an abundance.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So he thought to himself, ‘What shall I do, since I have nowhere to store my crops?’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then he said, ‘This is what I will do: I will tear down my barns and will build bigger ones, and there I will store up all my grain and my goods.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then I will say to myself, “You have plenty of good things laid up for many years. Take it easy. Eat, drink, and be merry!”’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But God said to him, ‘You fool! This very night your life will be required of you. Then who will own what you have accumulated?’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This is how it will be for anyone who stores up treasure for himself but is not rich toward God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat, or about your body, what you will wear.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For life is more than food, and the body more than clothes.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Consider the ravens: They do not sow or reap, they have no storehouse or barn; yet God feeds them. How much more valuable you are than the birds!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So if you cannot do such a small thing, why do you worry about the rest?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Consider how the lilies grow: They do not labor or spin. Yet I tell you, not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, how much more will He clothe you, O you of little faith!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And do not be concerned about what you will eat or drink. Do not worry about it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For the Gentiles of the world strive after all these things, and your Father knows that you need them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But seek His kingdom, and these things will be added unto you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do not be afraid, little flock, for your Father is pleased to give you the kingdom.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Sell your possessions and give to the poor. Provide yourselves with purses that will not wear out, an inexhaustible treasure in heaven, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Be dressed for service and keep your lamps burning.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then you will be like servants waiting for their master to return from the wedding banquet, so that when he comes and knocks, they can open the door for him at once.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed are those servants whom the master finds on watch when he returns. Truly I tell you, he will dress himself to serve and will have them recline at the table, and he himself will come and wait on them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Even if he comes in the second or third watch of the night and finds them alert, those servants will be blessed.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But understand this: If the homeowner had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have let his house be broken into.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Lord,
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: are You addressing this parable to us, or to everyone else as well?
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their portion at the proper time?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But suppose that servant says in his heart, ‘My master will be a long time in coming,’ and he begins to beat the menservants and maidservants, and to eat and drink and get drunk.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate. Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the unbelievers.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: That servant who knows his master’s will but does not get ready or follow his instructions will be beaten with many blows.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But the one who unknowingly does things worthy of punishment will be beaten with few blows. From everyone who has been given much, much will be required; and from him who has been entrusted with much, even more will be demanded.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I have come to ignite a fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I have a baptism to undergo, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do you think that I have come to bring peace to the earth? No, I tell you, but division.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: From now on, five in one household will be divided, three against two and two against three.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: They will be divided, father against son and son against father, mother against daughter and daughter against mother, mother-in-law against daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: As soon as you see a cloud rising in the west, you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and that is what happens.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And when the south wind blows, you say, ‘It will be hot,’ and it is.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and sky. Why don’t you know how to interpret the present time?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Make every effort to reconcile with your adversary while you are on your way to the magistrate. Otherwise, he may drag you off to the judge, and the judge may hand you over to the officer, and the officer may throw you into prison.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I tell you, you will not get out until you have paid the very last penny.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered this fate?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you too will all perish.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Or those eighteen who were killed when the tower of Siloam collapsed on them: Do you think that they were more sinful than all the others living in Jerusalem?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: No, I tell you. But unless you repent, you too will all perish.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: A man had a fig tree that was planted in his vineyard. He went to look for fruit on it, but did not find any.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So he said to the keeper of the vineyard, ‘Look, for the past three years I have come to search for fruit on this fig tree and haven’t found any. Therefore cut it down! Why should it use up the soil?’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘Sir,’ the man replied, ‘leave it alone again this year, until I dig around it and fertilize it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If it bears fruit next year, fine. But if not, you can cut it down.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Woman, you are set free from your disability.
name: Jesus

speaker: synagogue-leader
text: There are six days for work,
name: The synagogue leader

speaker: synagogue-leader
text: So come and be healed on those days and not on the Sabbath.
name: The synagogue leader

speaker: jesus
text: You hypocrites!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Does not each of you on the Sabbath untie his ox or donkey from the stall and lead it to water?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then should not this daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has kept bound for eighteen long years, be released from her bondage on the Sabbath day?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: What is the kingdom of God like? To what can I compare it?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: It is like a mustard seed that a man tossed into his garden. It grew and became a tree, and the birds of the air nested in its branches.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: To what can I compare the kingdom of God?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: It is like leaven that a woman took and mixed into three measures of flour, until all of it was leavened.
name: Jesus

speaker: someone
text: Lord,
name: Someone in the crowd

speaker: someone
text: will only a few people be saved?
name: Someone in the crowd

speaker: jesus
text: Make every effort to enter through the narrow door. For many, I tell you, will try to enter and will not be able.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: After the master of the house gets up and shuts the door, you will stand outside knocking and saying, ‘Lord, open the door for us.’ But he will reply, ‘I do not know where you are from.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then you will say, ‘We ate and drank with you, and you taught in our streets.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And he will answer, ‘I tell you, I do not know where you are from. Depart from me, all you evildoers.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in the kingdom of God, but you yourselves are thrown out.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: People will come from east and west and north and south, and will recline at the table in the kingdom of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And indeed, some who are last will be first, and some who are first will be last.
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: Leave this place and get away, because Herod wants to kill You.
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: Go tell that fox, ‘Look, I will keep driving out demons and healing people today and tomorrow, and on the third day I will reach My goal.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Nevertheless, I must keep going today and tomorrow and the next day, for it is not admissible for a prophet to perish outside of Jerusalem.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her, how often I have longed to gather your children together as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, but you were unwilling!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Look, your house is left to you desolate. And I tell you that you will not see Me again until you say, ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath or not?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Which of you whose son or ox falls into a pit on the Sabbath day will not immediately pull him out?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When you are invited to a wedding banquet, do not sit in the place of honor, in case someone more distinguished than you has been invited.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then the host who invited both of you will come and tell you, ‘Give this man your seat.’ And in humiliation, you will have to take the last place.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But when you are invited, go and sit in the last place, so that your host will come and tell you, ‘Friend, move up to a better place.’ Then you will be honored in front of everyone at the table with you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and the one who humbles himself will be exalted.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When you host a dinner or a banquet, do not invite your friends or brothers or relatives or rich neighbors. Otherwise, they may invite you in return, and you will be repaid.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But when you host a banquet, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, and the blind,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and you will be blessed. Since they cannot repay you, you will be repaid at the resurrection of the righteous.
name: Jesus

speaker: guest
text: Blessed is everyone who will eat at the feast in the kingdom of God.
name: A guest at the table

speaker: jesus
text: A certain man prepared a great banquet and invited many guests.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When it was time for the banquet, he sent his servant to tell those who had been invited, ‘Come, for everything is now ready.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But one after another they all began to make excuses. The first one said, ‘I have bought a field, and I need to go see it. Please excuse me.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I am going to try them out. Please excuse me.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Still another said, ‘I have married a wife, so I cannot come.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The servant returned and reported all this to his master. Then the owner of the house became angry and said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and alleys of the city, and bring in the poor, the crippled, the blind, and the lame.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘Sir,’ the servant replied, ‘what you ordered has been done, and there is still room.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So the master told his servant, ‘Go out to the highways and hedges and compel them to come in, so that my house will be full.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For I tell you, not one of those men who were invited will taste my banquet.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If anyone comes to Me and does not hate his father and mother and wife and children and brothers and sisters—yes, even his own life—he cannot be My disciple.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And whoever does not carry his cross and follow Me cannot be My disciple.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Which of you, wishing to build a tower, does not first sit down and count the cost to see if he has the resources to complete it?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Otherwise, if he lays the foundation and is unable to finish the work, everyone who sees it will ridicule him,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: saying, ‘This man could not finish what he started to build.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Or what king on his way to war with another king will not first sit down and consider whether he can engage with ten thousand men the one coming against him with twenty thousand?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And if he is unable, he will send a delegation while the other king is still far off, to ask for terms of peace.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: In the same way, any one of you who does not give up everything he has cannot be My disciple.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Salt is good, but if the salt loses its savor, with what will it be seasoned?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile, and it is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.
name: Jesus

speaker: pharisees
text: This man welcomes sinners and eats with them.
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: What man among you, if he has a hundred sheep and loses one of them, does not leave the ninety-nine in the pasture and go after the one that is lost, until he finds it?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: comes home, and calls together his friends and neighbors to tell them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost sheep!’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: In the same way, I tell you that there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents than over ninety-nine righteous ones who do not need to repent.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Or what woman who has ten silver coins and loses one of them does not light a lamp, sweep her house, and search carefully until she finds it?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And when she finds it, she calls together her friends and neighbors to say, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost coin.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: In the same way, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of God’s angels over one sinner who repents.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: There was a man who had two sons.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The younger son said to him, ‘Father, give me my share of the estate.’ So he divided his property between them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: After a few days, the younger son got everything together and journeyed to a distant country, where he squandered his wealth in wild living.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: After he had spent all he had, a severe famine swept through that country, and he began to be in need.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So he went and hired himself out to a citizen of that country, who sent him into his fields to feed the pigs.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He longed to fill his belly with the pods the pigs were eating, but no one would give him a thing.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Finally he came to his senses and said, ‘How many of my father’s hired servants have plenty of food? But here I am, starving to death!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I will get up and go back to my father and say to him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I am no longer worthy to be called your son. Make me like one of your hired servants.”’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So he got up and went to his father. But while he was still in the distance, his father saw him and was filled with compassion. He ran to his son, embraced him, and kissed him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The son declared, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But the father said to his servants, ‘Quick! Bring the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his finger and sandals on his feet.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Bring the fattened calf and kill it. Let us feast and celebrate.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For this son of mine was dead and is alive again! He was lost and is found!’ So they began to celebrate.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Meanwhile the older son was in the field, and as he approached the house, he heard music and dancing.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So he called one of the servants and asked what was going on.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘Your brother has returned,’ he said, ‘and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has him back safe and sound.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The older son became angry and refused to go in. So his father came out and pleaded with him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But he answered his father, ‘Look, all these years I have served you and never disobeyed a commandment of yours. Yet you never gave me even a young goat so I could celebrate with my friends.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But when this son of yours returns from squandering your wealth with prostitutes, you kill the fattened calf for him!’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘Son, you are always with me,’ the father said, ‘and all that is mine is yours.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But it was fitting to celebrate and be glad, because this brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: There was a rich man whose manager was accused of wasting his possessions.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So he called him in to ask, ‘What is this I hear about you? Turn in an account of your management, for you cannot be manager any longer.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The manager said to himself, ‘What shall I do, now that my master is taking away my position? I am too weak to dig and too ashamed to beg.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I know what I will do, so that after my removal from management, people will welcome me into their homes.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And he called in each one of his master’s debtors. ‘How much do you owe my master?’ he asked the first.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘A hundred measures of olive oil,’ he answered. ‘Take your bill,’ said the manager. ‘Sit down quickly, and write fifty.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then he asked another, ‘And how much do you owe?’ ‘A hundred measures of wheat,’ he replied. ‘Take your bill and write eighty,’ he told him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The master commended the dishonest manager because he had acted shrewdly. For the sons of this age are more shrewd in dealing with their own kind than are the sons of light.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I tell you, use worldly wealth to make friends for yourselves, so that when it is gone, they will welcome you into eternal dwellings.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whoever is faithful with very little will also be faithful with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So if you have not been faithful with worldly wealth, who will entrust you with true riches?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And if you have not been faithful with the belongings of another, who will give you belongings of your own?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: No servant can serve two masters. Either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and money.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You are the ones who justify yourselves before men, but God knows your hearts. For what is prized among men is detestable before God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The Law and the Prophets were proclaimed until John. Since that time, the gospel of the kingdom of God is being preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for a single stroke of a pen to drop out of the Law.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery, and he who marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Now there was a rich man dressed in purple and fine linen, who lived each day in joyous splendor.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And a beggar named Lazarus lay at his gate, covered with sores
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and longing to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Even the dogs came and licked his sores.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: One day the beggar died and was carried by the angels to Abraham’s side. And the rich man also died and was buried.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: In Hades, where he was in torment, he looked up and saw Abraham from afar, with Lazarus by his side.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So he cried out, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me and send Lazarus to dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue. For I am in agony in this fire.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But Abraham answered, ‘Child, remember that during your lifetime you received your good things, while Lazarus received bad things. But now he is comforted here, while you are in agony.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And besides all this, a great chasm has been fixed between us and you, so that even those who wish cannot cross from here to you, nor can anyone cross from there to us.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘Then I beg you, father,’ he said, ‘send Lazarus to my father’s house,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: for I have five brothers. Let him warn them, so that they will not also end up in this place of torment.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But Abraham replied, ‘They have Moses and the prophets; let your brothers listen to them.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘No, father Abraham,’ he said, ‘but if someone is sent to them from the dead, they will repent.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then Abraham said to him, ‘If they do not listen to Moses and the prophets, they will not be persuaded even if someone rises from the dead.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: It is inevitable that stumbling blocks will come, but woe to the one through whom they come!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: It would be better for him to have a millstone hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea than to cause one of these little ones to stumble.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Watch yourselves. If your brother sins, rebuke him; and if he repents, forgive him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Even if he sins against you seven times in a day, and seven times returns to say, ‘I repent,’ you must forgive him.
name: Jesus

speaker: apostles
text: Increase our faith!
name: The apostles

speaker: jesus
text: If you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and planted in the sea,’ and it will obey you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Which of you whose servant comes in from plowing or shepherding in the field will say to him, ‘Come at once and sit down to eat’?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Instead, won’t he tell him, ‘Prepare my meal and dress yourself to serve me while I eat and drink; and afterward you may eat and drink’?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Does he thank the servant because he did what he was told?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So you also, when you have done everything commanded of you, should say, ‘We are unworthy servants; we have only done our duty.’
name: Jesus

speaker: lepers
text: Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!
name: The ten lepers

speaker: jesus
text: Go, show yourselves to the priests.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Were not all ten cleansed?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Where then are the other nine?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Was no one found except this foreigner to return and give glory to God?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Rise and go; your faith has made you well!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The kingdom of God will not come with observable signs.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Nor will people say, ‘Look, here it is,’ or ‘There it is.’ For you see, the kingdom of God is in your midst.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The time is coming when you will long to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but you will not see it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: People will tell you, ‘Look, there He is!’ or ‘Look, here He is!’ Do not go out or chase after them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For just as the lightning flashes and lights up the sky from one end to the other, so will be the Son of Man in His day.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But first He must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Just as it was in the days of Noah, so also will it be in the days of the Son of Man:
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: People were eating and drinking, marrying and being given in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark. Then the flood came and destroyed them all.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: It was the same in the days of Lot: People were eating and drinking, buying and selling, planting and building.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But on the day Lot left Sodom, fire and sulfur rained down from heaven and destroyed them all.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: It will be just like that on the day the Son of Man is revealed.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: On that day, let no one on the housetop come down to retrieve his possessions. Likewise, let no one in the field return for anything he has left behind.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Remember Lot’s wife!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Whoever tries to save his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life will preserve it.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I tell you, on that night two people will be in one bed: one will be taken and the other left.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Two women will be grinding grain together: one will be taken and the other left.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Where, Lord?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: In a certain town there was a judge who neither feared God nor respected men.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And there was a widow in that town who kept appealing to him, ‘Give me justice against my adversary.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For a while he refused, but later he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect men,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: yet because this widow keeps pestering me, I will give her justice. Then she will stop wearing me out with her perpetual requests.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Listen to the words of the unjust judge.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Will not God bring about justice for His elect who cry out to Him day and night? Will He continue to defer their help?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I tell you, He will promptly carry out justice on their behalf. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will He find faith on earth?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Two men went up to the temple to pray. One was a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The Pharisee stood by himself and prayed, ‘God, I thank You that I am not like the other men—swindlers, evildoers, adulterers—or even like this tax collector.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I fast twice a week and pay tithes of all that I acquire.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But the tax collector stood at a distance, unwilling even to lift up his eyes to heaven. Instead, he beat his breast and said, ‘God, have mercy on me, a sinner!’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I tell you, this man, rather than the Pharisee, went home justified. For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but the one who humbles himself will be exalted.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Let the little children come to Me, and do not hinder them! For the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, anyone who does not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.
name: Jesus

speaker: ruler
text: Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life?
name: A certain ruler

speaker: jesus
text: Why do you call Me good?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: No one is good except God alone.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You know the commandments: ‘Do not commit adultery, do not murder, do not steal, do not bear false witness, honor your father and mother.’
name: Jesus

speaker: ruler
text: All these I have kept from my youth,
name: A certain ruler

speaker: jesus
text: You still lack one thing: Sell everything you own and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Indeed, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: Who then can be saved?
