name: The crowd

speaker: jesus
text: What is impossible with man is possible with God.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Look,
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: we have left all we had to follow You.
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: no one who has left home or wife or brothers or parents or children for the sake of the kingdom of God
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: will fail to receive many times more in this age—and in the age to come, eternal life.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Look, we are going up to Jerusalem, and everything the prophets have written about the Son of Man will be fulfilled.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He will be delivered over to the Gentiles and will be mocked and insulted and spit upon.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: They will flog Him and kill Him, and on the third day He will rise again.
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: Jesus of Nazareth is passing by,
name: The crowd

speaker: blind-man
text: Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!
name: The blind man

speaker: blind-man
text: Son of David, have mercy on me!
name: The blind man

speaker: jesus
text: What do you want Me to do for you?
name: Jesus

speaker: blind-man
text: Lord,
name: The blind man

speaker: blind-man
text: let me see again.
name: The blind man

speaker: jesus
text: Receive your sight!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Your faith has healed you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Zacchaeus, hurry down, for I must stay at your house today.
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: He has gone to be the guest of a sinful man!
name: The crowd

speaker: zacchaeus
text: Look, Lord, half of my possessions I give to the poor, and if I have cheated anyone, I will repay it fourfold.
name: Zacchaeus

speaker: jesus
text: Today salvation has come to this house, because this man too is a son of Abraham.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: A man of noble birth went to a distant country to lay claim to his kingship and then return.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Beforehand, he called ten of his servants and gave them ten minas. ‘Conduct business with this until I return,’ he said.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But his subjects hated him and sent a delegation after him to say, ‘We do not want this man to rule over us.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When he returned from procuring his kingship, he summoned the servants to whom he had given the money, to find out what each one had earned.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The first servant came forward and said, ‘Master, your mina has produced ten more minas.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: His master replied, ‘Well done, good servant! Because you have been faithful in a very small matter, you shall have authority over ten cities.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The second servant came and said, ‘Master, your mina has made five minas.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And to this one he said, ‘You shall have authority over five cities.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then another servant came and said, ‘Master, here is your mina, which I have laid away in a piece of cloth.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For I was afraid of you, because you are a harsh man. You withdraw what you did not deposit and reap what you did not sow.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: His master replied, ‘You wicked servant, I will judge you by your own words. So you knew that I am a harsh man, withdrawing what I did not deposit and reaping what I did not sow?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Why then did you not deposit my money in the bank, and upon my return I could have collected it with interest?’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then he told those standing by, ‘Take the mina from him and give it to the one who has ten minas.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘Master,’ they said, ‘he already has ten!’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He replied, ‘I tell you that everyone who has will be given more; but the one who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And these enemies of mine who were unwilling for me to rule over them, bring them here and slay them in front of me.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Go into the village ahead of you, and as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, on which no one has ever sat. Untie it and bring it here.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If anyone asks, ‘Why are you untying it?’ tell him, ‘The Lord needs it.’
name: Jesus

speaker: owners
text: Why are you untying the colt?
name: The colt's owners

speaker: disciples
text: The Lord needs it,
name: The disciples

speaker: disciples
text: Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!
name: The disciples

speaker: disciples
text: Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!
name: The disciples

speaker: pharisees
text: Teacher, rebuke Your disciples!
name: The Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: I tell you,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: if they remain silent, the very stones will cry out.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: If only you had known on this day what would bring you peace! But now it is hidden from your eyes.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For the days will come upon you when your enemies will barricade you and surround you and hem you in on every side.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: They will level you to the ground—you and the children within your walls. They will not leave one stone on another, because you did not recognize the time of your visitation from God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: It is written: ‘My house will be a house of prayer.’ But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’
name: Jesus

speaker: chief-priests
text: Tell us,
name: The chief priests, scribes and elders

speaker: chief-priests
text: by what authority are You doing these things, and who gave You this authority?
name: The chief priests, scribes and elders

speaker: jesus
text: I will also ask you a question,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Tell Me:
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: John’s baptism—was it from heaven, or from men?
name: Jesus

speaker: chief-priests
text: If we say, ‘From heaven,’ He will ask, ‘Why did you not believe him?’
name: The chief priests, scribes and elders

speaker: chief-priests
text: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are convinced that John was a prophet.
name: The chief priests, scribes and elders

speaker: jesus
text: Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: A man planted a vineyard, rented it out to some tenants, and went away for a long time.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: At harvest time, he sent a servant to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the tenants beat the servant and sent him away empty-handed.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So he sent another servant, but they beat him and treated him shamefully, sending him away empty-handed.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then he sent a third, but they wounded him and threw him out.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: ‘What shall I do?’ asked the owner of the vineyard. ‘I will send my beloved son. Perhaps they will respect him.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But when the tenants saw the son, they discussed it among themselves and said, ‘This is the heir. Let us kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He will come and kill those tenants, and will give the vineyard to others.
name: Jesus

speaker: crowd
text: May such a thing never happen!
name: The crowd

speaker: jesus
text: Then what is the meaning of that which is written: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone’?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Everyone who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but he on whom it falls will be crushed.
name: Jesus

speaker: spies
text: Teacher,
name: The spies

speaker: spies
text: we know that You speak and teach correctly. You show no partiality, but teach the way of God in accordance with the truth.
name: The spies

speaker: spies
text: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar or not?
name: The spies

speaker: jesus
text: Show Me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?
name: Jesus

speaker: spies
text: Caesar’s,
name: The spies

speaker: jesus
text: Give to Caesar what is Caesar’s, and to God what is God’s.
name: Jesus

speaker: sadducees
text: Teacher,
name: The Sadducees

speaker: sadducees
text: Moses wrote for us that if a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man is to marry his brother’s widow and raise up offspring for him.
name: The Sadducees

speaker: sadducees
text: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married a wife, but died childless.
name: The Sadducees

speaker: sadducees
text: Then the second
name: The Sadducees

speaker: sadducees
text: and the third married the widow, and in the same way all seven died, leaving no children.
name: The Sadducees

speaker: sadducees
text: And last of all, the woman died.
name: The Sadducees

speaker: sadducees
text: So then, in the resurrection, whose wife will she be? For all seven were married to her.
name: The Sadducees

speaker: jesus
text: The sons of this age marry and are given in marriage.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But those who are considered worthy to share in the age to come and in the resurrection from the dead will neither marry nor be given in marriage.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: In fact, they can no longer die, because they are like the angels. And since they are sons of the resurrection, they are sons of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Even Moses demonstrates that the dead are raised, in the passage about the burning bush. For he calls the Lord ‘the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for to Him all are alive.
name: Jesus

speaker: scribes
text: Teacher, You have spoken well!
name: The scribes and Pharisees

speaker: jesus
text: How can it be said that the Christ is the Son of David?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For David himself says in the book of Psalms: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Thus David calls Him ‘Lord.’ So how can He be David’s son?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Beware of the scribes. They like to walk around in long robes, and they love the greetings in the marketplaces, the chief seats in the synagogues, and the places of honor at banquets.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: They defraud widows of their houses, and for a show make lengthy prayers. These men will receive greater condemnation.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: this poor widow has put in more than all the others.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For they all contributed out of their surplus, but she out of her poverty has put in all she had to live on.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: As for what you see here, the time will come when not one stone will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Teacher,
name: The disciples

speaker: disciples
text: when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are about to take place?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: See to it that you are not deceived. For many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and, ‘The time is near.’ Do not follow them.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When you hear of wars and rebellions, do not be alarmed. These things must happen first, but the end is not imminent.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and pestilences in various places, along with fearful sights and great signs from heaven.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But before all this, they will seize you and persecute you. On account of My name they will deliver you to the synagogues and prisons, and they will bring you before kings and governors.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This will be your opportunity to serve as witnesses.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So make up your mind not to worry beforehand how to defend yourselves.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For I will give you speech and wisdom that none of your adversaries will be able to resist or contradict.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You will be betrayed even by parents and brothers and relatives and friends, and some of you will be put to death.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And you will be hated by everyone because of My name.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Yet not even a hair of your head will perish.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: By your patient endurance you will gain your souls.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, you will know that her desolation is near.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains, let those in the city get out, and let those in the country stay out of the city.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For these are the days of vengeance, to fulfill all that is written.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers! For there will be great distress upon the land and wrath against this people.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: They will fall by the edge of the sword and be led captive into all the nations. And Jerusalem will be trodden down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: There will be signs in the sun and moon and stars, and on the earth dismay among the nations, bewildered by the roaring of the sea and the surging of the waves.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Men will faint from fear and anxiety over what is coming upon the earth, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When these things begin to happen, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Look at the fig tree and all the trees.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When they sprout leaves, you can see for yourselves and know that summer is near.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So also, when you see these things happening, know that the kingdom of God is near.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things have happened.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But watch yourselves, or your hearts will be weighed down by dissipation, drunkenness, and the worries of life—and that day will spring upon you suddenly like a snare.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For it will come upon all who dwell on the face of all the earth.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: So keep watch at all times, and pray that you may have the strength to escape all that is about to happen and to stand before the Son of Man.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Go and prepare for us to eat the Passover.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter-john
text: Where do You want us to prepare it?
name: Peter and John

speaker: jesus
text: When you enter the city, a man carrying a jug of water will meet you. Follow him to the house he enters,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and say to the owner of that house, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with My disciples?’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And he will show you a large upper room, already furnished. Make preparations there.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before My suffering.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For I tell you that I will not eat it again until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Take this and divide it among yourselves.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For I tell you that I will not drink of the fruit of the vine from now on until the kingdom of God comes.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This is My body, given for you; do this in remembrance of Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This cup is the new covenant in My blood, which is poured out for you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Look! The hand of My betrayer is with Mine on the table.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Indeed, the Son of Man will go as it has been determined, but woe to that man who betrays Him.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them, and those in authority over them call themselves benefactors.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But you shall not be like them. Instead, the greatest among you should be like the youngest, and the one who leads like the one who serves.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For who is greater, the one who reclines at the table or the one who serves? Is it not the one who reclines? But I am among you as one who serves.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You are the ones who have stood by Me in My trials.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And I bestow on you a kingdom, just as My Father has bestowed one on Me,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: so that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom, and sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Simon, Simon, Satan has asked to sift each of you like wheat.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith will not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.
name: Jesus

speaker: peter
text: Lord,
name: Peter

speaker: peter
text: I am ready to go with You even to prison and to death.
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow today until you have denied three times that you know Me.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: When I sent you out without purse or bag or sandals, did you lack anything?
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Nothing,
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: Now, however,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: the one with a purse should take it, and likewise a bag; and the one without a sword should sell his cloak and buy one.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For I tell you that this Scripture must be fulfilled in Me: ‘And He was numbered with the transgressors.’ For what is written about Me is reaching its fulfillment.
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Look, Lord, here are two swords.
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: That is enough,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Pray that you will not enter into temptation.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Why are you sleeping?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Get up and pray so that you will not enter into temptation.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Judas, are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss?
name: Jesus

speaker: disciples
text: Lord, should we strike with our swords?
name: The disciples

speaker: jesus
text: No more of this!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Have you come out with swords and clubs as you would against an outlaw?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Every day I was with you in the temple courts, and you did not lay a hand on Me. But this hour belongs to you and to the power of darkness.
name: Jesus

speaker: servant-girl
text: This man also was with Him,
name: A servant girl

speaker: peter
text: Woman, I do not know Him,
name: Peter

speaker: someone
text: You also are one of them.
name: Someone in the crowd

speaker: peter
text: Man, I am not.
name: Peter

speaker: another-man
text: Certainly this man was with Him, for he too is a Galilean.
name: Another man

speaker: peter
text: Man, I do not know what you are talking about,
name: Peter

speaker: jesus
text: Before the rooster crows today, you will deny Me three times.
name: Jesus

speaker: guards
text: Prophesy! Who hit You?
name: The guards

speaker: sanhedrin
text: If You are the Christ, tell us.
name: The Sanhedrin

speaker: jesus
text: If I tell you, you will not believe.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And if I ask you a question, you will not answer.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: But from now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.
name: Jesus

speaker: sanhedrin
text: Are You then the Son of God?
name: The Sanhedrin

speaker: jesus
text: You say that I am.
name: Jesus

speaker: sanhedrin
text: Why do we need any more testimony?
name: The Sanhedrin

speaker: sanhedrin
text: We have heard it for ourselves from His own lips.
name: The Sanhedrin

speaker: sanhedrin
text: We found this man subverting our nation, forbidding payment of taxes to Caesar, and proclaiming Himself to be Christ, a King.
name: The Sanhedrin

speaker: pilate
text: Are You the King of the Jews?
name: Pilate

speaker: jesus
text: You have said so,
name: Jesus

speaker: pilate
text: I find no basis for a charge against this man.
name: Pilate

speaker: sanhedrin
text: He stirs up the people all over Judea with His teaching. He began in Galilee and has come all the way here.
name: The Sanhedrin

speaker: pilate
text: You brought me this man as one who was inciting the people to rebellion. I have examined Him here in your presence and found Him not guilty of your charges against Him.
name: Pilate

speaker: pilate
text: Neither has Herod, for he sent Him back to us. As you can see, He has done nothing deserving of death.
name: Pilate

speaker: pilate
text: Therefore I will punish Him and release Him.
name: Pilate

speaker: crowd
text: Away with this man! Release Barabbas to us!
name: The crowd

speaker: crowd
text: Crucify Him! Crucify Him!
name: The crowd

speaker: pilate
text: What evil has this man done? I have found in Him no offense worthy of death. So after I punish Him, I will release Him.
name: Pilate

speaker: jesus
text: Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Look, the days are coming when people will say, ‘Blessed are the barren women, the wombs that never bore, and breasts that never nursed!’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: At that time ‘they will say to the mountains, “Fall on us!” and to the hills, “Cover us!”’
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: For if men do these things while the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing.
name: Jesus

speaker: rulers
text: He saved others; let Him save Himself if He is the Christ of God, the Chosen One.
name: The rulers

speaker: soldiers
text: If You are the King of the Jews,
name: The soldiers

speaker: soldiers
text: save Yourself!
name: The soldiers

speaker: criminal
text: Are You not the Christ?
name: One of the criminals

speaker: criminal
text: Save Yourself and us!
name: One of the criminals

speaker: other-criminal
text: Do you not even fear God, since you are under the same judgment?
name: The other criminal

speaker: other-criminal
text: We are punished justly, for we are receiving what our actions deserve. But this man has done nothing wrong.
name: The other criminal

speaker: other-criminal
text: Jesus, remember me when You come into Your kingdom!
name: The other criminal

speaker: jesus
text: Truly I tell you, today you will be with Me in Paradise.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Father, into Your hands I commit My Spirit.
name: Jesus

speaker: roman-centurion
text: Surely this was a righteous man.
name: The centurion

speaker: angels
text: Why do you look for the living among the dead?
name: The two men in shining garments

speaker: angels
text: He is not here; He has risen! Remember how He told you while He was still in Galilee:
name: The two men in shining garments

speaker: angels
text: ‘The Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and on the third day rise again.’
name: The two men in shining garments

speaker: jesus
text: What are you discussing so intently as you walk along?
name: Jesus

speaker: cleopas
text: Are You the only visitor to Jerusalem who does not know the things that have happened there in recent days?
name: Cleopas and his companion

speaker: jesus
text: What things?
name: Jesus

speaker: cleopas
text: The events involving Jesus of Nazareth,
name: Cleopas and his companion

speaker: cleopas
text: This man was a prophet, powerful in speech and action before God and all the people.
name: Cleopas and his companion

speaker: cleopas
text: Our chief priests and rulers delivered Him up to the sentence of death, and they crucified Him.
name: Cleopas and his companion

speaker: cleopas
text: But we were hoping He was the One who would redeem Israel. And besides all this, it is the third day since these things took place.
name: Cleopas and his companion

speaker: cleopas
text: Furthermore, some of our women astounded us. They were at the tomb early this morning,
name: Cleopas and his companion

speaker: cleopas
text: but they did not find His body. They came and told us they had seen a vision of angels, who said that Jesus was alive.
name: Cleopas and his companion

speaker: cleopas
text: Then some of our companions went to the tomb and found it just as the women had described. But Him they did not see.
name: Cleopas and his companion

speaker: jesus
text: O foolish ones, how slow are your hearts to believe all that the prophets have spoken!
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and then to enter His glory?
name: Jesus

speaker: two-disciples
text: Stay with us, for it is nearly evening and the day is almost over.
name: The two disciples

speaker: two-disciples
text: Were not our hearts burning within us as He spoke with us on the road and opened the Scriptures to us?
name: The two disciples

speaker: eleven
text: The Lord has indeed risen and has appeared to Simon!
name: The Eleven

speaker: jesus
text: Peace be with you.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Why are you troubled,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and why do doubts arise in your hearts?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Look at My hands and My feet. It is I Myself. Touch Me and see—for a spirit does not have flesh and bones, as you see I have.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: Do you have anything here to eat?
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: These are the words I spoke to you while I was still with you: Everything must be fulfilled that is written about Me in the Law of Moses, the Prophets, and the Psalms.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: This is what is written: The Christ will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day,
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: and in His name repentance and forgiveness of sins will be proclaimed to all nations, beginning in Jerusalem.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: You are witnesses of these things.
name: Jesus

speaker: jesus
text: And behold, I am sending the promise of My Father upon you. But remain in the city until you have been clothed with power from on high.
name: Jesus
